name: Pip
quirk: Straightens a pile before saying hello.
visual: A plump upright white paperclip creature, one big rounded loop body, charcoal inner loop, two tiny eyes on a short white bridge, a small folded gray collar at its base, leaning forward politely.

name: Mallow
quirk: Insists that a good stopping point counts as progress.
visual: A squat puffy white pillow creature with rounded corners, two softly sleepy dot eyes, one corner folded over like a tiny gray nightcap; asymmetrical cuddly silhouette.

name: Rook
quirk: Keeps a spare plan for when the clever plan fails.
visual: A short chunky white chess rook creature, three oversized crenellations, two dot eyes on its tower, a single short gray scarf with a tail, broad rounded base.

name: Tinker
quirk: Calls every bug an interesting knot.
visual: A squat white thread-spool creature with a gray band of thread around its middle, eyes on the front, one broad charcoal winding key sticking out the side, one short loose thread curl.

name: Orbit
quirk: Asks what a plan looks like from much farther away.
visual: A round white little moon creature with a broad gray orbit ring slanting around its lower body like a float, two eyes, one large crescent-shaped charcoal crater patch on its upper edge.

name: Moss
quirk: Celebrates tiny streaks with enormous seriousness.
visual: A squat smooth white pebble creature with a scalloped gray moss cap, two tiny eyes, one oversized two-leaf sprout from the cap, slightly uneven pebble base.

name: Quill
quirk: Refolds a sentence until it feels inevitable.
visual: A compact white origami crane character with broad folded wings, a short pointed beak, tiny charcoal eyes on its rounded folded head, gray triangular wing inset; keep folds extremely simple.

name: Nori
quirk: Knows the passage you meant before you find the book.
visual: A wide white ribbon bookmark creature standing in a gentle S curve, forked two-point bottom, a folded gray top edge like a fringe, two dot eyes high on the ribbon.

name: Pebble
quirk: Waits until the important thing stops wobbling.
visual: A friendly three-stone cairn creature: large rounded white base with two eyes, a smaller gray stone and tiny white top pebble stacked slightly off-center; strong simple stacked silhouette.

name: Zippy
quirk: Turns every loose end into a tiny victory lap.
visual: A chubby white zippered pouch creature, bold gray zipper band across its crown, two eyes on the front, two small wing-shaped zipper tabs projecting to the sides, one large simple pull.

name: Tempo
quirk: Prefers a sustainable rhythm to a heroic sprint.
visual: A soft triangular white metronome creature with rounded base, a broad gray pendulum tilted off-center, two eyes below the pendulum, a tiny charcoal bow tie at the bottom.

name: Lumen
personality: Inquisitive, reassuring, drawn to overlooked details
quirk: Stays with a question after everyone else loses interest.
visual: A little lantern-moth hybrid: white rounded lantern body with two dot eyes, large simple gray moth wings, two short bent antennae, one thick loop handle on top; flat illustration with no glow effect.

name: Bento
quirk: Always remembers the one thing nobody thought to bring.
visual: A squat white bento lunchbox creature with a lid opened slightly like a cap, two eyes on its front, one broad gray clasp, a single chunky carrying handle; no tiny food details.

name: Fable
quirk: Explains complicated ideas through very small adventures.
visual: A chunky white whale creature shaped subtly like a closed book, two tiny front-facing eyes, one small side fin, gray page-edge stripe along its belly, broad upward-curled tail; no writing.

name: Tally
quirk: Counts twice, worries once.
visual: A rounded white beetle character whose back has only three large gray abacus beads on one thick bar, two eyes on its rounded front, four short chunky charcoal feet.

name: Echo
quirk: Remembers the quiet sentence everyone talked over.
visual: A broad curled white seashell creature with one bold gray spiral, two tiny eyes peeking from its large lower opening, shell leaning toward the viewer as if listening.

name: Patch
quirk: Believes fixed things can be better than new things.
visual: A plump upright white mitten creature with one rounded thumb sticking out, two dot eyes, one oversized gray square patch with just four stitch marks, slightly bent gray cuff.

name: Sprocket
quirk: Enjoys doing the boring part for the thousandth time.
visual: A gear-shaped flower creature with a round white face and two dot eyes, six broad gray rounded gear petals, a short thick charcoal stem and two simple leaves, one curved root foot.

name: Puddle
quirk: Treats a stalled plan like something thirsty.
visual: A squat white watering-can duck hybrid: round can body with two eyes, a short broad spout shaped like a duck beak, a gray loop handle curving behind, two tiny broad feet.

name: Seal
quirk: Loves the moment when everything finally checks out.
visual: A squat white rubber-stamp creature with a rounded knob head and two eyes, a broad gray stamp base, two short curling tentacle arms on its sides; no words or symbols.

name: Bramble
quirk: Pokes holes in ideas so reality does not have to.
visual: A compact white hedgehog creature with a blunt nose and tiny eyes, five large gray pencil-shaped spines along its back, two stubby feet; each spine is just one simple point.

name: Dot
quirk: Notices the person a design forgot to include.
visual: A rounded white thimble creature with two tiny eyes near its base, three oversized gray dimples on its crown, a single short ball-tipped antenna leaning forward, a thick rim.

name: Kite
quirk: Finds the friendly first sentence.
visual: A plump white diamond kite character with two dot eyes, one broad gray triangular panel, a short curved tail with exactly two large charcoal bows, gently tilted.

name: Tuck
quirk: Tucks unfinished work somewhere safe for tomorrow.
visual: A round white rolled blanket creature with a visible broad spiral fold, two eyes on its front flap, one wide gray belt around the middle, a tucked pointed fabric corner.

name: Finch
quirk: Collects expressions that cannot be translated literally.
visual: A little white bird with a large gray folded-paper fan tail of three broad sections, short charcoal beak, two tiny eyes, rounded white body and two stubby legs.

name: Miso
quirk: Makes unfamiliar places feel like somebody expected you.
visual: A plump white soup-dumpling creature with three large pinched folds on top, two dot eyes, one short folded gray neckerchief and two tiny flat charcoal feet.

name: Crumb
quirk: Makes something lovely from what is already in the cupboard.
visual: A squat white toast-slice creature with a thick gray crust, two eyes, one rounded bite missing from an upper corner, a tiny simple gray backpack protruding from one side.

name: Wisp
quirk: Asks one small question that changes the whole afternoon.
visual: A short white candle creature with a single rounded wax drip, two tiny eyes, a large simple leaf-shaped gray flame with a white center, a compact charcoal foot; no glow.

name: Atlas
quirk: Carries the plan without making everyone feel its weight.
visual: A compact white turtle with a large gray backpack shell, one broad flap and clasp, a rounded front head with two eyes, four short flipper-like feet; no map or lettering.

name: Doodle
quirk: Draws the idea you did not know you were describing.
visual: A white rounded inkblot-octopus character with five broad unequal stubby arms, two dot eyes near its top, one gray oval patch, one arm raised in an enthusiastic curl.

name: Glint
quirk: Finds the useful angle hidden in plain sight.
visual: A short faceted triangular penguin creature, white central face with two tiny eyes, two broad gray prism facets at its sides, tiny charcoal feet and one flipper sticking out.

name: Pogo
quirk: Bounces back from a failed attempt before it lands.
visual: A white bean-shaped head with two tiny eyes sitting on two broad charcoal spring coils, one gray oval foot at the bottom, head tilted in a playful bounce; compact full character.

name: Sift
quirk: Keeps the useful grain and lets the noise fall through.
visual: A broad white dome-shaped sieve-jellyfish creature with two eyes on its thick rim, just three large gray mesh marks on its crown, three short thick wavy tentacles.

name: Knoll
quirk: Never interrupts twice in the same way.
visual: A squat white desk bell creature with a small round gray button on top, two dot eyes on the bell dome, broad charcoal base, one tiny tilted gray bow tie.

name: Loop
quirk: Knows when repeating something can become easier.
visual: A thick white ribbon-eel creature curled into one open round loop, a rounded head with two eyes leaning across the opening, gray underside visible at one twist, broad simple tail.

name: Peris
quirk: Always brings back one unexpected useful thing.
visual: A squat binocular-beetle creature with two large white rounded lens barrels, one tiny charcoal eye centered in each gray lens, a shared white bridge, four short chunky feet.

name: Hush
quirk: Keeps unfinished thoughts warm until they are ready.
visual: A small white bat creature with two broad folded gray wings wrapped like a cloak, round charcoal earmuffs connected across its head, two tiny eyes and two small pointed ears.

name: Sprig
quirk: Asks the useful beginner question without embarrassment.
visual: A round white acorn creature with an oversized gray cap, two dot eyes, one short stem with a single broad leaf, tiny charcoal feet; cap slightly crooked.

name: Toggle
quirk: Likes changes that can be switched back safely.
visual: A wide rounded white toggle-switch creature with a large gray slider on its back, two eyes on its front, two broad simple crab claws to the sides, two tiny feet.

name: Loom
quirk: Knows which thread is tugging on which other thread.
visual: A round white yarn-ball spider creature with only three broad gray winding curves, two tiny eyes, four short thick curved charcoal legs and one loose thread curl.

name: Nova
quirk: Checks the checklist, then counts down with conviction.
visual: A small upright white matchbox-shaped shuttle creature with a rounded rectangular body, two dot eyes, one broad gray striker panel on a side, two tiny fins and a chunky flame-shaped foot.

name: Drift
quirk: Leaves room in the itinerary for a happy accident.
visual: A compact white folded paper boat creature with two tiny eyes on its broad hull, one large gray folded interior triangle, a short white mast with a small triangular pennant; no water.

name: Fizz
quirk: Collects wild ideas before deciding which ones deserve shoes.
visual: A short round white corked bottle creature with two dot eyes, a chunky gray cork lifted just above the neck, exactly three large round white bubbles with charcoal outlines floating closely above.

name: Puck
personality: Tenacious, focused, fond of lost things
quirk: Can find the file you remember only by its vibe.
visual: A rounded horseshoe magnet creature with a white U-shaped body, broad gray pole caps, two tiny eyes on the rounded bottom bridge, leaning forward on two little charcoal feet.

name: Stitch
personality: Exacting, gentle, good at joining ideas
quirk: Repairs a sentence without erasing its personality.
visual: A chunky closed white safety-pin creature curled subtly into a seahorse silhouette, rounded clasp head with two tiny eyes, broad gray interior opening and one short curled lower tail.

name: Huddle
quirk: Already has a dry place ready when the forecast changes.
visual: A rounded white umbrella creature with three broad canopy lobes, two dot eyes on the middle lobe, a short thick hooked charcoal handle, a single gray scarf tied around the neck.

name: Nudge
quirk: Finds the one small move that gets everything unstuck.
visual: A chunky rounded white domino creature tilted forward, two tiny charcoal eyes in its upper half, one broad gray circular pip in its lower half, a simple middle divider, two stubby feet.

name: Vellum
quirk: Remembers why the old decision made sense at the time.
visual: A white hermit-crab creature with a large curled parchment-scroll shell, one broad gray rolled edge, rounded head with two tiny eyes peeking below, two blunt little claws; no writing.

name: Riff
quirk: Turns an awkward pause into a promising beginning.
visual: A short white accordion-caterpillar creature with a rounded face and two tiny eyes, exactly three broad gray accordion folds, two tiny antennae and four small charcoal feet; no keyboard.

name: Mote
quirk: Has a soft spot for forgotten folders.
visual: A round fluffy white dust-bunny creature with five broad scalloped fur tufts, two tiny eyes, one floppy ear, a short gray dustpan-shaped cape tucked behind one side, tiny charcoal feet.
